title: Evaluation Model
description: Structured sidecar for working/evaluation-model.md. The typed representation of THIS solicitation's rubric: evaluation factors, relative weighting, pass/fail items, and submission constraints, each with sentence-level provenance and a human review status. Derived from the markdown table by scripts/extract-evaluation-model.py; do not hand-edit the JSON.

criteria.description: One entry per evaluation criterion. Running-log discipline: re-extraction replaces only rows with origin 'extracted'/'ai-inferred' AND status 'extracted'; manual rows and confirmed/edited/rejected rows are never destroyed.

id.description: Stable identifier (e.g., 'EC-3'). Preserved across re-extraction for reviewed rows.

criterion.description: The criterion text, normally a verbatim sentence from the solicitation

kind.description: factor = a scored evaluation factor; weighting = a relative-importance statement; pass-fail = a disqualifier / gate; constraint = a submission constraint (page limit, format, deadline) stated in Section L/M context

weight_text.description: Relative-importance phrase when stated (e.g., 'significantly more important than'); empty otherwise

detail.description: Evaluator notes: what good looks like, hot buttons. Empty when not stated.

source_file.description: Provenance: the inputs/ file the sentence came from. Empty ONLY for origin 'ai-inferred' or 'manual'.

source_section.description: Provenance: detected solicitation section context ('section-l', 'section-m', or empty)

origin.description: extracted = deterministic pattern match with provenance; ai-inferred = added by the model enrichment pass (no source sentence — never silently mixed with cited rows); manual = human-added

status.description: Human review state. 'confirmed'/'edited'/'rejected' rows survive re-extraction; 'rejected' rows are kept in the running log but excluded from the drafting context block.

confirmed.description: Rows with status confirmed or edited
